_meta.description: Queryable FAQ/knowledge-base seed data for the Logica Infoway chatbot. Each entry has a confidence tag — 'confirmed' answers are safe to serve as-is; 'needs_confirmation' answers contain a placeholder and must NOT be edited with invented specifics until real business data is supplied.

schema.question: canonical user-facing question
schema.answer: stored answer text; may contain a literal [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: ...] placeholder
schema.last_updated: ISO date this entry's content was last reviewed

entries.question: How can I track my order?
entries.answer: Once your order ships, you'll get a tracking link via email/SMS. You can also check status anytime in "My Account → Order History."

entries.question: How long does delivery take?
entries.answer: [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: exact delivery timelines per city — e.g. Kolkata same-day/next-day vs Delhi/Mumbai/Bangalore 3-5 days? Any difference for mobiles vs laptops vs bulky items like monitors/desktops?]

entries.question: Do you offer free shipping?
entries.answer: Delivery is calculated at checkout, once we have your address — you will see the exact amount before you pay. For a quote before ordering, call us on +91 7003999192 or use the contact form.

entries.question: Which cities do you deliver to?
entries.answer: We currently serve Kolkata, Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Lucknow, Hyderabad, Mumbai, and Bangalore, with wider pan-India shipping available for most products. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: is pan-India shipping actually available, or only these 8 cities?]

entries.question: What happens if my order is delayed or lost in transit?
entries.answer: [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: actual escalation process — refund, replacement, courier claim timeline?]

entries.question: What is your return policy?
entries.answer: [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: return window in days — commonly 7 days for electronics, sometimes shorter for mobiles/opened items. Does it vary by category?]

entries.question: Can I cancel my order after placing it?
entries.answer: You can cancel any order that hasn't shipped yet from "My Account → Orders." Once shipped, cancellation may not be possible and you'll need to use the return process instead.

entries.question: How long do refunds take?
entries.answer: [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: refund timeline after return approval — e.g. 5-7 business days? Same for all payment methods (UPI vs card vs netbanking)?]

entries.question: What if my product arrives damaged or defective?
entries.answer: Contact us within [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: number of hours/days] of delivery with photos of the damage, and we'll arrange a replacement or refund. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: is return shipping free for damaged/defective items?]

entries.question: Do opened/used electronics qualify for return?
entries.answer: [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: policy on opened-box returns — many retailers restrict this for mobiles/laptops due to activation/serial number tracking.]

entries.question: What payment methods do you accept?
entries.answer: We accept UPI, all major debit/credit cards, net banking, and popular wallets. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: which specific wallets, and is EMI available — and if so, on which banks/card types and above what order value?]

entries.question: Is it safe to pay on your website?
entries.answer: Yes — all payments are processed through Razorpay over an encrypted connection. We never see or store your full card details. You can pay by UPI, card, net banking or no-cost EMI.

entries.question: My payment was deducted but the order didn't go through. What now?
entries.answer: This usually resolves automatically within [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: timeframe, e.g. 5-7 business days] as the amount is refunded by your bank. If it's not resolved by then, contact our support team with your transaction ID.

entries.question: Can I get a GST invoice?
entries.answer: Yes, a GST-compliant invoice is generated automatically for every order and available in "My Account → Orders." For business/bulk orders needing a specific GSTIN on the invoice, [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: process — checkout field, or a support request?]

entries.question: Are your products genuine/original?
entries.answer: Yes, we are an authorized retailer for all brands we sell, including Samsung, Apple, HP, Dell, Lenovo, Asus, Acer, and others. Every product comes with full manufacturer warranty.

entries.question: What's the warranty period on my product?
entries.answer: Warranty periods vary by brand and category. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: standard warranty lengths — e.g. mobiles 1 year, laptops 1-2 years, accessories 6 months? Or does this vary entirely by manufacturer terms?]

entries.question: How do I claim warranty service?
entries.answer: [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: is this handled in-house by Logica service centers, or does the customer go directly to the brand's authorized service center? Matters a lot for the actual answer.]

entries.question: How do I know if a product is in stock?
entries.answer: Stock status is shown live on every product page. If an item shows "Out of stock," you can request to be notified when it's back.

entries.question: Can I compare products before buying?
entries.answer: Yes, use the "Compare" option on any product listing to compare specs side-by-side across similar products.

entries.question: How do I create an account?
entries.answer: Click "My Account" in the top menu and sign up with your email/phone number. You can also check out as a guest without creating an account.

entries.question: How do I view my past orders?
entries.answer: Go to "My Account → Order History" to see all past and current orders, invoices, and tracking info.

entries.question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
entries.answer: Click "Forgot Password" on the login page and follow the reset link sent to your registered email.

entries.question: Can I save multiple delivery addresses?
entries.answer: Yes, you can save and manage multiple addresses under "My Account → Addresses" for faster checkout.

entries.question: Do you offer bulk pricing for businesses/institutions?
entries.answer: Yes, we work with corporate, government, and educational institutions on bulk orders with dedicated pricing. Submit a request through our Corporate Orders page and our team will get in touch. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: typical response time for bulk quote requests?]

entries.question: Can I get a dedicated account manager for ongoing orders?
entries.answer: [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: is this actually offered, and at what order volume/relationship threshold?]

entries.question: Do you provide AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts) or IT support services?
entries.answer: Yes — beyond retail, we provide networking, hardware, and IT infrastructure solutions with maintenance support for institutional clients. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: is this still an active offering, and who should bulk/enterprise IT-solution buyers contact?]

entries.question: Do you have physical stores I can visit?
entries.answer: We have a presence across Kolkata, Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Lucknow, Hyderabad, Mumbai, and Bangalore. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: exact store addresses per city for a store locator — or is this purely an online + B2B delivery presence with no walk-in retail stores?]

entries.question: How can I contact customer support?
entries.answer: [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: current support phone number and hours — existing site lists +91 7003999192, Mon-Sat 10AM-7PM — confirm this is still accurate.]

entries.question: How long has Logica been in business?
entries.answer: Logica Infoway (formerly Eastern Logica Infoway Limited) has been serving customers for over 30 years, with headquarters in Kolkata and a pan-India presence.

entries.question: Is Logica a registered/listed company?
entries.answer: Yes, Logica Infoway Limited is a publicly listed company. CIN L30007WB1995PLC073218, GSTIN 19AABCE0772B1Z1. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: confirm these should be surfaced via chatbot if asked — likely fine since already public on the website.]

entries.question: I got a call/email asking me to pay outside your website. Is this legitimate?
entries.answer: No — this is fraudulent. Logica Infoway never requests payment outside our official website or asks for OTPs, card details, or UPI PINs over phone/email. Do not share any payment information, and report the incident to us immediately at [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: fraud-reporting email/number — likely info@logicainfoway.com, confirm].

entries.question: How do I verify if a Logica representative contacting me is real?
entries.answer: Genuine Logica communication will never ask for your card number, CVV, OTP, or UPI PIN. If in doubt, hang up/ignore the message and contact us directly through the official number on our website.
